headline: Our First Veteran Took the Controls
body: The first of the five discovery flights we're sponsoring happened today. Justin flew out of the Waycross-Ware County Airport with Runway One Nine Aviation, left seat, hands on the yoke.
That is the part that matters to me. Not a ride in the back, not a tour of the field. A veteran actually flying the airplane.
Four seats are still open. Flights run through October 2026, scheduled with Runway One Nine Aviation. If you want one, reach out any of these ways:

headline: Putting Veterans in the Air
location: Runway One Nine Aviation, Waycross, GA
body: We're sponsoring five free discovery flights for veterans in the Fort Stewart, Waycross and Kings Bay area, in partnership with Runway One Nine Aviation in Waycross, Georgia. A real aircraft and a certificated flight instructor, on us.

I soloed for the first time this summer, and I want to share that with the veterans who earned it. The FAA's MOSAIC rule, which began taking effect in October 2025, expanded the aircraft a sport pilot can fly. A discovery flight is where that path can start.
Flights run September through October 2026, scheduled with Runway One Nine Aviation. To get a seat, reach out any of these ways:
teaser: Five free discovery flights for veterans in the Fort Stewart, Waycross and Kings Bay area, with Runway One Nine Aviation. A real aircraft and an instructor, on us.

sponsored.description: Five free discovery flights for veterans in the Fort Stewart, Waycross and Kings Bay area of Georgia, flown with a certificated flight instructor.

headline: Backing the Home Team at Liberty County
location: Donell Woods Stadium, Liberty County, GA
body: We're sponsoring the Liberty County High School Panthers football team for the full 2026 season. Our name is on the board at Donell Woods Stadium every home game, in Fort Stewart country, in front of the military families we built VA Ready for.
We'd rather earn trust in the stands than buy it in an ad.
teaser: Our name on the board at Donell Woods Stadium every home game, in front of the military families we built VA Ready for.
photo_alt: The Liberty County High School video board at Donell Woods Stadium showing a VA Ready and Vet Ready sponsor ad during a Panthers home game

headline: On the Road for the Military Community in Texas
body: We took VA Ready on the road to Copperas Cove, Texas, right outside Fort Hood, to be part of a veterans event and connect with the military community in person.
Jason, our founder and developer (left), and Andrew, who leads marketing and outreach (right), ran the table.
Showing up where veterans and military families actually are is the whole point. We'd rather be in the room than behind a screen.
teaser: We took VA Ready on the road to Copperas Cove, Texas, right outside Fort Hood, to connect with the military community in person.
